```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,sf,tmap,httr)
```

```{r}
folder_path <- "data/aspatial/ACRA"
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path,
                        pattern = "^ACRA*.*\\.csv$",
                        full.names = TRUE)
acra_data <- file_list %>%
  map_dfr(read_csv)
```

```{r}
write_rds(acra_data,
          "data/rds/acra_data.rds")
```

```{r}
biz_56111 <- acra_data %>%
  select(1:24) %>%
  filter(primary_ssic_code == 56111) %>% # Restaurants
  rename(date = registration_incorporation_date) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         Year = year(date),
         Month_num = month(date,
                           label =TRUE,
                           abbr =TRUE)) %>%
  # make sure the post_code are 6 digits
  mutate(postal_code = str_pad(postal_code,
                               width =6,
                               side = "left",pad ="0"))  %>% 
  filter(Year == 2025)
```

```{r}
length(file_list); ncol(acra_data); names(acra_data)[1:10]
```

```{r}
postcodes <- unique(biz_56111$postal_code)

url <- "https://onemap.gov.sg/api/common/elastic/search"

found <- data.frame()
not_found <- data.frame(postcode = character())

for(pc in postcodes){
  query <- list(
    searchVal = pc,
    returnGeom = "y",
    getAddrDetails = "y",
    pageNum = "1"
  )
  
  res <- GET(url,query = query)
  json <- content(res)
  
  if(json$found !=0) {
    df <- as.data.frame(json$results,stringAsFactors = FALSE)
    df$input_postcode <- pc
    found <- bind_rows(found,df)
  } else{
    not_found <- bind_rows(nit_found,data.frame(postcode = pc))
  }
}
```

```{r}
biz_56111 = biz_56111 %>%
  left_join(found,
            by = c('postal_code' = 'POSTAL'))
```

```{r}
biz_56111_sf <- st_as_sf(biz_56111,
                         coords = c("X","Y"),
                         crs = 3414)
```
